title: Orunmila update record, schema version 1: DRAFT
description: One update of Orunmila by itself: the version it ran and the one it was offered, npm's integrity hash of the package it checked, the result of the new version's self-check, and whether it switched. A failed self-check keeps the version it ran, and is recorded too. Follows the update log's header (updates-header.schema.json) in one hash chain.
$comment: agent's proposal Q44 (a), approved by O 2026-11-25 (LD299): "the version from and to, npm's integrity hash, the self-check's result, the time"; `switched` and the field names are the agent's choice (LD329). Unknown fields are allowed (LD17).

record.description: Marks this line as an update record.

seq.description: Its place in the update log, from 1.
seq.$comment: brief v4 line 237; agent's choice, LD329

at.description: Wall-clock time of the switch, or of the refusal.
at.$comment: agent's proposal Q44 (a), approved by O (LD299): the time; the form of the session header's observed_at

from.description: The version Orunmila ran before; null when no version was installed in its home yet (the first one).
from.$comment: agent's proposal Q44 (a), approved by O (LD299): the version from

to.description: The version it was offered and checked.
to.$comment: agent's proposal Q44 (a), approved by O (LD299): the version to

integrity.description: npm's integrity hash of the package checked, in the registry's own form (Subresource Integrity: the algorithm, a dash, the digest in base64).
integrity.$comment: agent's proposal Q44 (a), approved by O (LD299): npm's integrity hash

self_check.description: The new version's self-check: pass, or fail (it is then not switched to).
self_check.$comment: agent's proposal Q44 (a), approved by O (LD299): the self-check's result

switched.description: Whether Orunmila now runs the new version.
